- The final exam will take place in-person on Monday, July 27 from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM. This exam is an opportunity to demonstrate what you've learned in the course, primarily on content **since the last exam** (but not completely excluding material you learned previously - it's difficult to completely separate out certain topics as they build on each other).  

- The exam will be closed-book. 

- You should bring something to write with. Nothing else is permitted (i.e. calculators not permitted, cheat sheets not permitted.)

- Content covered: Lectures 13-15, Lab 3

## Types of questions

- The questions may be mostly short answer and one set of true/false questions - although maybe one or two multiple choice

- To prepare, review the definitions, concepts, and examples in the lectures. Review all homework assignments and the lab assignment listed above. With each question, ask yourself "Why?" Why does this matter? Why might this concept be helpful when doing biostatistics in the real world? Can I explain this question to someone else who does not have statistics experience?

- Code, Applied and Conceptual will be mixed in across all questions 

## Resources for reviewing

- No formula sheet will be provided; all questions can be answered without one.

- A topics list is available as `final-topics`.

- We will review in class on Thursday, July 23.

- Additionally, there are two sets of review questions on Canvas, and I'll post the solutions to those after class on Thursday.
